scenes.png: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one 2-by-2 landscape atlas for a Chinese wuxia QQ chat game, four equal rectangular tiles in one image. Draw four distinct quiet adventure settings: upper left a misty bamboo mountain path, upper right a rainy ancient market street with lanterns, lower left a remote mountain training courtyard, lower right a riverside inn and bridge at dusk. Style: polished hand-painted Chinese wuxia game illustration, ink outlines and restrained watercolor, warm parchment highlights, jade green and deep blue shadows, atmospheric and readable at small sizes. No people, no creatures. Each tile must be a complete landscape, edges aligned exactly at the center, no frames, no gutters, no UI, no text, no letters, no logos. Landscape canvas, 3:2 overall aspect ratio. Leave calm low-detail foreground space useful behind game cards.

Refined hand-painted Chinese fantasy game art, strong ink lines, soft watercolor shading, confident relaxed poses, readable silhouettes. No panel borders, no gutters, no graphic UI, no text, no numerals, no watermarks, no magical glows, no sexualized costume. Overall wide 3:2 composition, characters each centered in their one-third column.
